In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 4-space]], the '''great 120-cell honeycomb''' is one of four [[regular polytope|regular]] star-[[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycombs]]. With [[Schläfli symbol]] {5,5/2,5,3}, it has three [[great 120-cell]]s around each face. Acronym: gohitte{{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/o3o5o52o5x.htm (o3o5o5/2o5x - gohitte)]}}

It is [[dual polytope|dual]] to the [[order-5 icosahedral 120-cell honeycomb]].

It can be seen as a [[stellation#Naming stellations|greatening]] of the [[120-cell honeycomb]], and is thus analogous to the three-dimensional [[great dodecahedron]] {5,5/2} and four-dimensional [[great 120-cell]] {5,5/2,5}. It has [[density (polytope)|density]] 10.
